Every brand needs a center of gravity.

@event @campaign @film

We are a creative agency based in Muscat, Oman. We help brands tell their stories clearly and well through film, photography, design, and campaigns, built from strategy to delivery. We've worked with national companies and well-known brands across Oman, on projects ranging from IPO campaigns to seasonal launches and live events. We focus on doing the work properly, from the first idea to the final result.

What we do

Three disciplines, one team. Every project moves through all of them.

THINKTHINK

Strategy

Where every project begins

  1. Campaign strategyFull campaign planning, concept development, messaging framework and rollout plan.
  2. Creative conceptBig ideas, campaign concepts, scripts, storyboards and visual direction.
  3. Creative directionArt direction, visual identity guidance and on-set creative leadership.

MAKEMAKE

Production

The craft that carries the idea

  1. Film productionBrand films, commercials, music videos, documentaries and event coverage.
  2. PhotographyCommercial, lifestyle, corporate, editorial, product and campaign photography.
  3. Graphic designPrint, digital, social, OOH layouts, presentations and branded materials.
  4. Motion graphicsIllustration, 2D and 3D animation, and social content.
  5. Audio productionRadio ads, voice-over, jingles and sound design.

MOVEMOVE

Activation

Where the work meets the world

  1. Campaign managementEnd-to-end delivery, OOH placements, radio spots, media coordination, timelines and reporting.
